references.text: The midwives hid the Hebrew baby boys from Pharaoh, a similar act of protecting life by hiding someone from authorities.
Moses was hidden by his mother to protect him, just as Rahab hid the spies to protect them.
Michal helped David escape and lied to Saul's men about where he was, a parallel to Rahab's action of hiding the spies and misleading pursuers.
Obadiah hid one hundred prophets from Jezebel, a similar act of protecting God's servants by hiding them.
The book of Hebrews mentions Rahab's faith when she welcomed the spies, referring specifically to this event where she hid them.
James mentions Rahab as an example of faith shown through actions when she received the messengers and sent them out by another route.
